dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Who would've thought that one might find such a study outside the treasure trove of the magus-custodian of books...? It is worthy of one's extended stay, and may invoke seven blessings of the Prinzessin out of ten!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: What mein Fräulein means to say is that most of the literature in this study is of interest to her.
